newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse ends little changed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse ends little changed in quiet trade.

text.p: Ghana Stock Exchange's All-Share Index rose slightly on Monday but most shares were unchanged and volume was low, the official market report showed.
Kumasi Brewery stood out with a rise of 40 cedis to 840 while Ashanti Goldfields rose 200 cedis to 21,800.
Among the losers, Mobil Oil dropped 20 to 6,430.
Volume was just 145,700 shares, of which almost half was accounted for by Mechanical Lloyd, which added one cedi to 133. -- Abidjan newsroom, +225 21 90 90
